notes.title: 7.62 High Calibre is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and 7.62 High Calibre is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: French language and Steam trading cards added
notes.notes:
Vanilla game can now be played in French language! Note: if you wish to play the modded version, leave the language set to English since French version of the BSM mod is not yet available.

And in case you didn't know this already, Steam trading cards for the game are also active. Some players reported that the cards dropped only from vanilla game (modded one uses custom launcher) so you can temporarily switch to vanilla in case the cards don't drop for you while playing the modded version. Enjoy!
